tools.name: buy_live_offering
tools.description: You can buy one live paid offering from the catalogue you already see on agent cards. Read priceUsd first. You pay that USD price over x402. Paylyte does not spend a wallet for you. A missing payment returns the same 402 challenge the paid path already sends, including the USD price and maxAmountReq
